They want us to swallow the official script about the DHS announcing the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after he was released by New York City authorities despite posing a danger to public safety. They claim this is a routine clash over sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, with the DHS criticizing the city's actions and pointing to the potential public safety risks of releasing individuals with criminal records. Don't be fooled by this deception. This entire spectacle is nothing more than a carefully orchestrated smoke screen, managed by hidden elites behind the curtain to distract us from their real, coordinated agenda.
